tests: a charter or a declared manifest that git cannot show as one regular file, a charter deleted or unparseable at the head, each classify the change pair

dangerousStates.find:
/* A side git could not show as one regular file (a symlink, a submodule). */
      return { tier: "pair", reason: "the charter changed and its two sides were not read, fail closed" };
dangerousStates.replace:
/* A side git could not show as one regular file (a symlink, a submodule). */
      return { tier: "single", reason: "the charter changed and its two sides were not read, fail closed" };

dangerousStates.find:
/* Unreadable at the merge base or the head (CR-M6P2A-08, CR-M6P2B-09). */
      return { tier: "pair", reason: "a declared manifest whose two sides were not read, fail closed" };
dangerousStates.replace:
/* Unreadable at the merge base or the head (CR-M6P2A-08, CR-M6P2B-09). */
      return { tier: "single", reason: "a declared manifest whose two sides were not read, fail closed" };

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Real output of git ls-tree as blobAt in src/gates/merge-preconditions.ts runs it on the side each arm makes unreadable or absent, captured 2026-09-30 by the M6-P5 implementer with git 2.43.0 against the repositories test/merge-preconditions.test.ts stages in stageReadFailure: mode 120000 blob for a symlinked charter or manifest, nothing for a deleted charter. The named test replays each arm's command and compares git's live output with the recorded stdout before it asks the shipped classifier.
